configurations.name: numora
runtimeArgs: const http=require('http'),fs=require('fs'),p=require('path');const t={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.svg':'image/svg+xml'};http.createServer((q,s)=>{let f=p.join(process.cwd(),decodeURIComponent(q.url.split('?')[0]));if(f.endsWith(p.sep))f=p.join(f,'index.html');fs.readFile(f,(e,d)=>{if(e){s.writeHead(404);return s.end('404');}s.writeHead(200,{'Content-Type':t[p.extname(f)]||'application/octet-stream'});s.end(d);});}).listen(4321,()=>console.log('Numora en http://localhost:4321'));
